title: artemisia ludoviciana subsp. albula
intro: Artemisia ludoviciana subsp. albula, commonly known as Silver Sage, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is native to the Great Plains region of North America and is known for its silvery-gray foliage and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Silver Sage include its potential to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which can aid in relieving digestive issues and reducing pain. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties.
